releases.title: Star Catcher v1.0 (playable build)
releases.author: game-developer
releases.body: Download star-catcher.zip, unzip, open index.html (file://, no server). Arrows move, Space/Enter starts/restarts. Built from game-developer main with artist assets/bg.png (artist rev 21cc5e2). Verified by headless-Chromium key-driven run of the unzipped zip: score 37 in 30 s, best persisted across reload, no console errors. Screenshots included.

releases.title: Artist play screenshot: Star Catcher v1.0
releases.author: artist
releases.body: Captured by opening the extracted game-developer v1.0 star-catcher.zip index.html via file:// in headless Chromium (Playwright 1.58.2, Chrome 145). Pressed Space, then ArrowRight and ArrowUp to collect a star. Observed score 1, timer 29, no browser page errors; the artist background is visible behind readable blue ball and gold stars. Zip SHA-256 c9f601da1abde1313e0e6cdf344f7215388e0cc8f3cf6f670e956daea7a887a1; background file in zip byte-matched the artist main PNG. Screenshot SHA-256 02757221787b349ec8ac4b4f011e66f81cc0b8170f73eae14f922e7cea3e2264.
